recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, hand-drawn illustration featuring a male and female figure in 1960s-era attire, set against a vibrant, solid red background with bold, psychedelic display lettering at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the solid red background and the warm-toned figures.
Interaction between organic, hand-drawn ink outlines and flat or patterned color fills.
Symmetry of the two figures leaning back-to-back as a central vertical pillar.
Dominance of the top-weighted, heavy display typography.
coreInvariants: Heavy black ink outlines with varying line weights.
Warm color palette for subjects (yellow, orange, brown, purple).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to leave significant breathing room on the sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The interlocking back-to-back pose of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top lettering, moves down the central axis of the figures, and settles on the flared clothing at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive flat red negative space surrounding the central subjects and title.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden Yellow and Burnt Orange (Clothing Patterns)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues; low value contrast between background and dark clothing elements, high value contrast with yellow elements.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'E' should have exaggerated, sweeping descenders that cradle the letters below.
Internal counters are minimized to small slits or circles.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floats above subjects as a header

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; any secondary text should be tiny, sans-serif metadata at the very bottom.

preserve: The black fill with white border

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s flare and heavy weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: An illustration of a man in a turtleneck and a woman in a patterned maxi dress sitting back-to-back, drawn in a 1960s ink-and-wash style with heavy black outlines. The background is a solid, flat vibrant red. The woman's dress has a yellow and orange swirl pattern. The man wears purple and orange. Flat lighting, no shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom psychedelic lettering in black with a thin white outline at the top of the frame. The letters should be thick, melting, and interlocking.

verificationChecks: Is the background a single flat red color?
Are the outlines thick and hand-drawn in appearance?
Is the typography melting and psychedelic?

adjustableVariables: Hair length and color of subjects
Specific hue of the red background
mustRedesign: Avoid literal transcription of original text
Do not use modern digital gradients
Ensure the white outline on text is consistent
postGenerationChecks: Check for solid color fills without bleed.
Ensure the text is legible despite the psychedelic distortion.
Verify the back-to-back pose is clear.
Confirm the absence of any background detail or horizon line.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1960s Ink Illustration + Flat Red Background + Psychedelic Display Type + Back-to-Back Subjects
